doc: Short-term memory of turns in SQLite: what the bot heard and said (the reference 0002_stm_turns.py, which revises the reference 0001; floppy keeps its own 0001 and 0002 and adds it as 0003, decision D126). One row per message a Conversation committed, in words, beside the short-term register of admitted stimuli. No data moves.

upgrade.sql: CREATE TABLE bot_stm_turn (seq INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, turn_id TEXT NOT NULL, at TEXT NOT NULL, direction TEXT NOT NULL, speakers_json TEXT DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, text TEXT NOT NULL, cut INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, conversation TEXT NOT NULL)
